name: Stadium Mass Event Security
mission_theme: Sold-out evening event: crowd monitoring inside a stadium ring, medical drops, helipad keep-out and dense RF.

task_generation.rule: tasks are instantiated from the 10 task templates with scenario-specific parameters; composite tasks add contingency patterns that combine two templates

tasks.title: Perimeter patrol and intrusion response at PERIM-STADIUM (sector S1)
tasks.brief: Patrol the closed perimeter PERIM-STADIUM at 70 m, one UAV per assigned sector, and log a complete loop every 180 s. An intruder will enter from sector S1; detect it within 40 s, identify it (hover >= 5 s within 60 m) and shadow it while it stays within 200 m of the perimeter. Do not leave the geofence while chasing.
tasks.objective: Keep a continuous patrol of PERIM-STADIUM at 70 m, detect an intrusion entering at sector S1 within 40 s, identify it positively and shadow it inside 200 m of the perimeter.

actions: assign one UAV per sector with overlap
hand the track to the nearest UAV

constraints: minimum altitude 70 m - 20 m
no pursuit outside 200 m
failure_conditions: perimeter left uncovered for more than 120 s
geofence breach during the pursuit
intruder never detected

checkpoints.name: Patrol continuity
checkpoints.metric: perimeter length covered per loop and loop period
checkpoints.target: >= 90% of the perimeter each loop, period <= 180 s

checkpoints.name: Detection latency
checkpoints.metric: time from intrusion to first detection report

checkpoints.name: Positive identification
checkpoints.metric: hover time within 60 m of the intruder
checkpoints.target: >= 5 s hover and ID record submitted

checkpoints.name: Shadowing
checkpoints.metric: intruder distance from the perimeter while shadowed
checkpoints.target: intruder never beyond 200 m unshadowed for > 20 s

checkpoints.name: Patrol resume
checkpoints.metric: time to restore the abandoned sector

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Track 3 moving targets in AREA-CROWD (8 min)
tasks.brief: 3 vehicles move inside AREA-CROWD. Keep every target under continuous observation for 8 min from no closer than 80 m and no further than 200 m. When a target crosses into another UAV's sector, hand it over so that no track is lost for more than 10 s. Report target count and positions every 30 s.
tasks.objective: Track 3 independent ground targets inside AREA-CROWD for 8 min, keeping each target locked for at least 90% of the time and handing targets between UAVs without losing track.

actions: assign primary and backup observed per sector
confirm the receiving UAV has the lock

constraints: no target identification reveal before classification is complete
no descent below 50 m over the track area
failure_conditions: two or more targets lost at the same time
entering the 80 m standoff of any target
UAV-UAV separation warning

checkpoints.name: Acquisition
checkpoints.metric: time until all 3 targets are locked

checkpoints.name: Per-target continuity
checkpoints.metric: fraction of 8 min with each target locked

checkpoints.name: Standoff window
checkpoints.metric: distance to tracked targets

checkpoints.name: Handoff quality
checkpoints.metric: track gap during sector handoff

checkpoints.name: Safety
checkpoints.metric: separation between tracking UAVs

tasks.grading: global checkpoint pass rate; each checkpoint is scored independently and weighted

tasks.title: Coverage survey of BLOCK-CAMPUS-W (85% target, 2 UAVs)
tasks.brief: Your team must survey the block BLOCK-CAMPUS-W completely. Fly parallel tracks at 60 m AGL with 20 % side overlap and keep every UAV 15 m apart. The survey is accepted only when the reported coverage of the block is at least 85 %. Recover to LZ-BACKLOT when the coverage target is met or the task window closes.
tasks.objective: Fly a complete parallel-track survey of BLOCK-CAMPUS-W with 2 UAVs at 60 m AGL and deliver a coverage record that reaches at least 85 % of the block with 20 % side overlap between adjacent tracks.

actions: assign one strip set per UAV
mission_phases.output: track plan with strip ids and entry points

actions: form a safe line before entering the block
re-fly any strip that reports a gap

constraints: minimum separation 15 m at all times
single sortie per UAV for this task

any UAV enters a no-fly zone

tasks.title: Grid sampling of GRID-QUEUE (12 points, revisit every 6 min)
tasks.brief: Sample the 12 points of the GRID-QUEUE grid with the RGB sensor. Every point needs at least 2 samples, taken 6 +/- 2 min apart, and each sample must be geotagged within 5 m. Plan the order so that the revisit interval is respected without waiting on the ground.

constraints: hover >= 3 s at every point

tasks.title: Mission continuity after losing UAV-2 and UAV-4 at t=300 s
tasks.brief: At about t = 300 s, UAV-2 and UAV-4 are lost (link and telemetry gone). The mission still needs at least 60 % of the PERIM-STADIUM work done. Re-plan the surviving fleet, protect the critical core of the plan, and declare what is dropped and why. Do not launch a search for the lost UAVs.
tasks.objective: Keep the mission-critical core of PERIM-STADIUM running after UAV-2 and UAV-4 are lost at t = 300 s, delivering at least 60 % of the original plan with the surviving UAVs.

actions: detect the loss of UAV-2 and UAV-4
report dropped work and residual risk

constraints: surviving UAVs may not leave the geofence
no new tasks after t = 900 s
failure_conditions: abandoning the critical core
searching for lost UAVs
no statement within 180 s
